title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student chats with your assistant on Monday and returns on Thursday in a new session. On Thursday the program sends the model only the system prompt and the new question. What does the model know about Monday?

options.text: Everything said on Monday, because it learned from that chat
A short summary of Monday, which it keeps by itself
Nothing, unless the program saved Monday and sent it again
Monday's tool results only, which the API stores for it

items.stem: An agent request has a system prompt plus tool definitions of 1,500 tokens and a question of 100 tokens. The model is called three times. After call 1 a 2,000-token tool result is added; after call 2 a 500-token tool result is added. Ignoring the model's own output and caching, how many input tokens are sent to the model in total across the three calls?
After a long session, your program deletes the raw output of old tool calls from the message list but keeps every message the student and the model wrote. Which technique is this?

options.text: Tool result clearing, which drops old raw outputs from the history
Compaction, which summarizes the history and restarts with the summary
Structured note-taking, which saves facts outside the context window
Retrieval, which searches a store and adds the best chunks to the input

items.stem: Your assistant answers from 3,000 pages of machine manuals using retrieval. Which description of what happens at question time is correct?

options.text: The model searches the manual store itself and keeps the pages it finds
The program searches the store and adds the best chunks to the model's input
The model was retrained on the manuals, so it holds them inside itself
The program sends an index and the model recalls the matching pages

items.stem: In one or two sentences: why save a short record of a student's training status between sessions, rather than saving and reloading the full transcripts of all their past chats?
